days.title: Eastern Valleys and Visitor Center
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Nationalpark-Zentrum
stops.detail: The national park center with an exhibition and a small botanical garden is located in Kongsvoll on the E 6.

stops.name: Stroplsjødalen
stops.detail: The best chances to spot musk oxen are in Stroplsjødalen and Kaldvelldalen.

days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Snøhetta
stops.detail: The most popular hiking destination in the western part of the park is Snøhetta (2286 m), the highest peak in the area.

stops.name: Reinheim
stops.detail: At its feet lies the self-service DNT hut Reinheim (keys available in Kongsvoll).

stops.name: Bekkelegret
stops.detail: Best access is from the E 6 via the RV 29 to Dalen and further to Bekkelegret, the (state) horse station.
